papers.title_en: DASS: A Solver-Adaptable Dynamic Auxiliary Search Strategy for Symbolic Regression
papers.authors: Yuxiao Hu, Qian Li, Ding Wang, Yekun Zheng, Jinyue Yan, Yuntian Chen
papers.evidence: 面向符号回归的动态辅助搜索策略
papers.tldr: 符号回归能从数据中发现可解释的数学表达式，但搜索空间巨大、组合爆炸严重，精度与效率难以兼顾。论文提出 DASS，一种可适配不同求解器的动态辅助搜索策略：用高潜力基函数项张成辅助子空间，通过多环境评估估计项效用、以 Gibbs 后验更新潜力分数，并用求解器产出的高质量解反哺基项集合，形成闭环优化。在 LLM-SRBench 上，DASS 显著提升原有求解器精度，运行时间增幅可控。
papers.abstract_en: Symbolic regression (SR) aims to discover interpretable mathematical expressions from data and plays a key role in scientific discovery. However, existing methods face a common bottleneck: the enormous search space and severe combinatorial explosion make it difficult to achieve a favorable trade-off between accuracy and algorithmic efficiency. We argue that, in addition to designing increasingly complex solver-specific SR strategies, an equally promising direction is to equip them with a shareable auxiliary strategy that can provide reliable search guidance. To this end, we propose DASS, a solver-adaptable Dynamic Auxiliary Search Strategy that improves SR by constructing and refining a high-potential auxiliary search subspace. DASS represents the auxiliary search space as a functional subspace spanned by a set of high-potential basis function terms. It estimates term utility through multi-environment evaluation, filters unstable guidance, and updates term potential scores with a Gibbs posterior, thereby calibrating the subspace to provide more reliable guidance for downstream solvers. The high-quality solutions produced by the solver are used to update the set of basis terms. This forms a virtuous closed-loop optimization process: the subspace guides the downstream solver, and the solver feedback reshapes the subspace for subsequent exploration. DASS can be easily integrated with various types of SR solvers. Extensive experiments on LLM-SRBench show that DASS significantly improves the accuracy of original solvers with a manageable increase in runtime.

papers.title_en: Improving Neural Symbolic Regression with a Diverse Prior and Post-training Alignment
papers.authors: David Otte, Jörg K. H. Franke, Frank Hutter
papers.evidence: 直接改进神经符号回归的训练
papers.tldr: 符号回归需在组合空间中搜索拟合表达式，神经符号回归虽能摊销搜索，但在真实含噪数据上仍逊于遗传编程。RASR 从训练入手，设计更贴近真实数据的合成先验，并采用监督预训练加强化学习后训练，以留出拟合和表达式大小奖励对齐推理。在 SRBench 2.0 黑盒赛道，RASR 取得最佳平均测试 R² 排名，多个变体占据精度-复杂度帕累托前沿。它还在 Strogatz 上恢复最多真值表达式，Feynman 上具竞争力。
papers.abstract_en: Symbolic regression is the problem of finding an expression that fits a dataset. Solving it requires searching a combinatorial space of candidate expressions. Neural symbolic regression can amortize that search by training a model once on synthetic data and then predicting expressions for a new dataset. But existing models still underperform genetic programming on real, noisy data. We argue that the deficit lies in the training rather than in the paradigm, and present RASR (Reinforced Amortized Symbolic Regression), a method with two key changes to the training recipe. First, we design a synthetic prior that narrows the gap with real-world data: inputs come from the prior of a tabular foundation model; constants are sampled bottom-up, conditioned on the data; targets carry heteroscedastic and structured noise; and everything is standardized. Second, we split training into two stages. Supervised pre-training maximizes the token-level likelihood of a reference expression. This is followed by reinforcement-learning post-training that aligns the model with its inference-time use by rewarding held-out fit and penalizing expression size. On the black-box track of SRBench 2.0, RASR achieves the best mean test $R^2$ rank of all evaluated methods. Three RASR variants, trained with different size penalties, make up most of the accuracy-complexity Pareto front. On Strogatz, our method recovers more ground-truth expressions than any baseline, and on Feynman it is competitive with the best-performing methods.

papers.title_en: TabMF: Learning Dataset Representations with Tabular Foundation Models
papers.authors: Rafiq Kamel, Nicolas Atienza, Aziz Fouché, Nicola Cancedda, Josif Grabocka
papers.evidence: 将预训练表格基础模型复用为数据集编码器
papers.tldr: 监督数据集的表示可支持数据集检索与分布偏移监控，但现有方法依赖手工元特征或专用编码器。TabMF 将预训练表格基础模型改造为数据集编码器，加入架构感知读出，并用合成监督数据的随机视图做对比后训练。在 TabICLv2 与 TabPFN-2.5 上实例化后，于未见真实数据集六项任务评测，两个编码器取得最强综合表现。该工作显示预测预训练已隐含数据集级结构，并为数据集级表示学习提供可复用新范式。
papers.abstract_en: Representations of supervised datasets support higher-level machine-learning tasks such as dataset retrieval and distribution-shift monitoring. However, existing approaches typically rely either on hand-crafted meta-features or on dataset encoders trained specifically for representation learning. We introduce TabMF, a framework that repurposes pretrained tabular foundation models (TFMs) as encoders of supervised datasets. TabMF equips a predictive TFM with an architecture-aware dataset-level readout and adapts the model end-to-end using contrastive post-training on stochastic views of synthetic supervised datasets. We instantiate TabMF on TabICLv2 and TabPFN-2.5 and evaluate the resulting representations across six tasks on unseen real datasets. Simple frozen TFM readouts yield competitive representations, indicating that predictive pretraining already induces substantial dataset-level structure. The two TabMF encoders obtain the strongest aggregate performance among the evaluated learned and classical dataset representations, with particularly strong results in dataset retrieval, compact benchmark construction, and distribution-shift severity assessment.

papers.title_en: Recurrent In-Context Learning for Tabular Foundation Models
papers.authors: Tejas Vaidhya, Gaurav Sahu, Irina Rish
papers.evidence: 表格基础模型的循环式上下文学习
papers.tldr: 表格基础模型通过上下文学习适应新数据集，但其ICL阶段的计算深度通常与独立参数层数绑定。Tab-Loop将TabICLv2的12个非共享ICL块替换为4个共享块并重复k次，其余组件不变。在匹配预训练与推理算力下，它以少62%的参数（10.4M对27.6M）匹配基线：留出对数损失0.4583对0.4588，TALENT平均准确率84.10%对83.92%，TabArena Elo为1409对1396；一个4块非共享对照模型同算力下多看32%训练表仍落后（83.46%，Elo 1343）。准确率随循环次数增加而提升，并在训练范围之外保持，说明该规模下ICL阶段更需深度而非独立参数，且深度可在推理时选择。
papers.abstract_en: Tabular foundation models adapt to new datasets through in-context learning (ICL), and, like most transformers, they tie computational depth to the number of independently parameterized layers. We ask whether the ICL stage of such a model needs a distinct set of parameters for every layer, or only depth. We introduce Tab-Loop, which replaces the 12 untied ICL blocks of TabICLv2 with 4 tied blocks applied $k$ times and changes nothing else: the encoders, decoder, synthetic prior and training recipe are shared with an untied baseline trained for the same compute. At matched pretraining compute (18.2 EFLOP) and matched inference compute (12 block applications), Tab-Loop matches the baseline with 62\% fewer parameters (10.4M vs.\ 27.6M): held-out log loss is 0.4583 vs.\ 0.4588, mean accuracy on 200 TALENT datasets is 84.10\% vs.\ 83.92\%, and Elo on 38 TabArena datasets is 1409 vs.\ 1396. A 4-block untied control with Tab-Loop's parameter count, which sees 32\% more training tables for the same compute, trails both (83.46\%; Elo 1343). Because weights are shared, depth becomes a choice made at inference. Accuracy rises with the number of loops through the trained range and holds beyond it, and continued training with deeper loops extends the useful range, reaching the baseline's stage-2 scores at 4--5$\times$ its inference compute. At this scale, the ICL stage of a tabular foundation model needs depth more than it needs distinct parameters.

papers.title_en: Learning to Design SR Solvers: Harness Optimization for Symbolic Regression
papers.authors: Qian Li, Yuxiao Hu, Qihao Duan, Jinyue Yan, Yuntian Chen
papers.evidence: 面向符号回归的代理框架优化
papers.tldr: 符号回归旨在从观测数据中发现可解释的显式方程，但近期基于大语言模型与智能体的方法多依赖人工设计的工作流和提示，难以充分利用搜索先验与数值反馈。HarnessSR将符号回归智能体的harness本身视为优化目标，联合优化角色提示与工作流，并通过工具接口兼容PySR或基于LLM的方程生成器。在LLM-SRBench的LSR-Synth上，该方法在三个骨干模型上取得平均ID Acc0.01为61.33%，较次优基线相对提升45.0%。这说明对求解器设计进行显式优化，可构建可复用且更强的方程发现智能体。
papers.abstract_en: Symbolic regression (SR) seeks explicit equations that explain observed data, and recent methods increasingly employ large language models (LLMs) and agents for equation discovery. However, these systems typically rely on manually designed workflows and prompts. We argue that the SR agent harness should itself be an optimization target: its design shapes search priors and how numerical feedback guides subsequent equation refinement. We therefore propose HarnessSR, a framework for jointly optimizing prompts and workflows to construct reusable SR agents. During both harness optimization and agent execution, HarnessSR supports either PySR or an LLM-based equation generator through tool-specific interfaces, allowing the framework to optimize search guidance for different equation-discovery mechanisms. HarnessSR first optimizes role prompts through equation-discovery feedback in basic workflows, then jointly searches prompt assignments and workflows with brief adaptation to align the two. Finally, it refines role instructions through reflection on residual patterns, candidate equation structures, and search outcomes, improving how these signals guide subsequent equation search. On LSR-Synth in LLM-SRBench, HarnessSR achieves a mean ID $\mathrm{Acc}_{0.01}$ of 61.33% across three backbones, a 45.0% relative improvement over the next-best baseline.

papers.title_en: TILE: Bridging LLMs and Table Foundation Models for Tabular Learning with Strings
papers.authors: Félix Lefebvre, David Holzmüller, Gioia Blayer, Myung Jun Kim, Marine Le Morvan, Gaël Varoquaux
papers.evidence: 面向含字符串表格的表格基础模型
papers.tldr: 真实表格常混合数值与字符串列：表格基础模型需把字符串数值化，LLM 有语义知识却不擅长表格预测。TILE 用行序列化提供跨列上下文、中间层抽取避开下一词预测层、按列池化消除均值池化的长度偏差，并以旁路特征让数值与类别绕过 LLM。在 100 个数据集上，它于 89% 的切分胜过最强基线，跨 7 个 LLM 与 10 种表格学习器均有提升，并在 108 数据集的 STRABLE 基准排名第一，表明 LLM 与表格的接口设计同样关键。
papers.abstract_en: Real-world tables are often heterogeneous, combining numerical features with free-form string columns. Table foundation models (TFMs) excel on numerical tables but require strings to be encoded numerically, while large language models (LLMs) hold semantic knowledge but are not designed for tabular predictions. Most existing bridges use LLMs as plug-in encoders for cell strings, yet how to extract representations effectively for tabular learning remains underexplored. We show that the interface between LLMs and tables matter as much as the LLM itself. Applied cell-wise, larger LLMs do not give better features. With our interface, the same LLMs improve steadily with size. TILE (Table-Interfaced LLM Embeddings) combines four ingredients: row serialization to provide cross-column context, intermediate-layer extraction to avoid layers specialized for next-token prediction, columnar pooling to remove mean pooling's length bias, and by-pass features to route numbers and categories past the LLM. Paired with TFMs, TILE sets a new state of the art for tables with strings. Across 100 datasets, it beats the strongest baseline on 89% of splits, with gains across 7 LLMs and 10 tabular learners, and ranks first on the 108-dataset STRABLE benchmark.

papers.title_en: Kernel Autoresearch for Open-Ended Model Discovery
papers.authors: Richard Cornelius Suwandi, Feng Yin, Kevin Murphy
papers.evidence: 面向开放式模型发现的核自动研究
papers.tldr: 自动核设计存在两难：固定语法保证有效但限制搜索，无限制程序又难保有效；测试中22–58%的LLM生成核在尺度或维度变化时失效。Kernaut将核设计视为开放式模型发现，让编码智能体写程序，用构造契约保证有效性，并以质量-多样性存档和新颖性筛选引导探索。结果显示，发现的核能泛化到未见任务，在黑箱优化和酶动力学预测上超过元学习深度核与ARD基线，且可解释、可人工改进。
papers.abstract_en: Kernels encode the inductive bias of a wide range of machine learning models, yet automated kernel design faces a fundamental dilemma. A fixed grammar of base kernels and operators guarantees validity but limits the search to structures expressible by those building blocks. Conversely, unrestricted programs remove this limitation but no longer guarantee validity. In our stress tests, 22-58% of LLM-generated kernels that pass numerical checks on random inputs fail when evaluated at different scales or dimensions. We propose Kernel Autoresearch (Kernaut), which treats kernel design as open-ended model discovery. Coding agents write kernels as programs, while construction contracts ensure that every accepted kernel is valid. A quality-diversity archive retains high-performing kernels with distinct behaviors, and novelty screening steers agents toward functionally new candidates. Our experiments demonstrate that the discovered kernels encode reusable inductive biases that generalize to unseen tasks. On held-out black-box optimization families, a discovered kernel outperforms a meta-learned deep kernel trained on the same episodes. Furthermore, kernels discovered from ten enzyme-kinetic rate laws achieve lower error than tuned ARD and deep kernel baselines on five unseen mechanisms. The discovered kernels are also interpretable programs that human researchers can refine: a human-refined version of one further reduces the held-out predictive error by 5.7% and optimization regret by 7.8%.

papers.title_en: TabGift: A Context-Efficient Foundation Model for Tabular Data Generation
papers.authors: Yu-Sheng Li, Jun-Peng Jiang, Han-Jia Ye
papers.evidence: 面向数据生成的上下文高效表格基础模型
papers.tldr: 表格数据生成需在样本稀缺时仍还原真实分布，但现有表格基础模型依赖大上下文，难以直接用于少样本生成。TabGift 将异质表格经预训练编码器映射到共享隐空间，用上下文扩散模型在小规模干净样本条件下去噪，并由数据集专属MLP解码回原空间。在7个分类和11个回归数据集上，它提升合成数据质量，少上下文场景增益尤其显著，且适配与生成速度更快。该工作为稀缺数据下的表格生成提供了上下文高效的基础模型范式。
papers.abstract_en: Tabular data generation aims to synthesize realistic samples from limited observations while faithfully capturing the underlying data distribution. Tabular foundation models (TFMs), pretrained on diverse tabular tasks and adapted through in-context learning, have demonstrated strong predictive capabilities, suggesting the potential of extending this paradigm to tabular data generation. However, the strong predictive performance of TFMs often relies on sufficiently large context sets, whereas tabular generation is typically needed precisely when target data are scarce. Extending the foundation-model paradigm to generation therefore requires reliable distribution inference from only a limited context. To this end, we propose TabGift, a context-efficient tabular foundation model enabling both efficient distribution modeling and effective generation from only a few context samples. TabGift maps heterogeneous tables into a shared latent space with a pretrained tabular encoder, where an in-context diffusion model learns to denoise latent samples conditioned on a small set of clean examples. This design transfers generative priors across datasets and enables distribution inference from limited context, while a lightweight dataset-specific MLP decoder maps generated representations back to the original data space. Experiments on 7 classification and 11 regression datasets show that TabGift consistently outperforms representative baselines in synthetic data quality, with particularly strong gains under limited-context settings, while achieving substantially faster adaptation and generation.

papers.title_en: RT-J: Large-Scale Pretraining of Relational Transformers for Context-Efficient Predictions
papers.authors: Rishabh Ranjan, Vignesh Kothapalli, Harshvardhan Agarwal, Charilaos Kanatsoulis, Roshan Upendra, Tom Palczewski, Carlos Guestrin, Jure Leskovec
papers.evidence: 面向表格的关系基础模型
papers.tldr: 关系数据库基础模型迁移到新数据集常需上万样本。作者提出85M参数的RT-J，构建639个数据库、6023个LLM预测任务的Join语料，用8192单元长上下文与随机游走检索器预训练，并结合上下文调优与集成。在RelBench上下文回归上，RT-J平均少用10倍示例即可匹配LLM-agent/RDBLearn特征工程加TabICLv2/LightGBM的强基线。该工作推进关系数据上下文高效预测，强调真实语义、上下文工程与大规模预训练。
papers.abstract_en: Foundation models for tables and relational databases are increasingly used for predictive tasks across various scientific and industrial domains. However, adapting existing models to unseen datasets requires tens of thousands of examples. Here we introduce RT-J, an 85M-parameter relational foundation model (RFM) that makes accurate predictions even with hundreds of in-context examples or fewer. To achieve this, we first assemble the Join, a large collection of 639 web-crawled databases with 6,023 LLM-generated forecasting tasks. We pretrain with long contexts of up to 8,192 database cells, using in-context examples from a novel lightweight random-walk retriever. Finally, we leverage context tuning and ensembling to scale up test-time compute. On in-context regression tasks from RelBench, RT-J requires 10x fewer examples on average to match strong feature engineering pipelines with LLM-agent or RDBLearn featurizers and TabICLv2 or LightGBM predictors. Overall, our work pushes the frontier for context-efficient predictions on relational data and highlights the importance of real-world semantics, context engineering and large-scale pretraining for RFMs.
